follow-up time: Not specified, but included a follow-up hysteroscopy and laparoscopy
exposure: Uterine torsion (180° around the longitudinal axis and 90° around the transversal axis)
cohort: A 28-year-old woman in her 34th week of pregnancy (G2P1)
finding: This case report describes a rare case of uterine torsion diagnosed during a caesarean section, with successful surgical management and problem-free healing of the uterine wound.
